lines.beaver_en: Hello. Welcome to the consultation room.
lines.learner: 안녕하세요. 요즘 마음이 너무 힘들어서 왔어요.
lines.en: Hello. I came because I've been struggling a lot lately.
lines.roman: annyeonghaseyo. yojeum maeumi neomu himdeureoseo wasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Could you tell me what's been hard for you?
lines.learner: 한 달째 잠을 못 자요. 불면증인 것 같아요.
lines.en: I haven't slept for a month. I think it's insomnia.
lines.roman: han daljjae jameul mot jjayo. bulmyeonjeungin geot gatayo.

lines.beaver_en: You must be very tired. How is your mood?
lines.en: I feel down all the time. I'm worried it's depression.

lines.beaver: 그런 걱정이 드실 수 있어요. 언제부터 그러셨어요?
lines.beaver_en: That's an understandable worry. Since when?
lines.beaver_roman: geureon geokjeongi deusil su isseoyo. eonjebuteo geureosyeosseoyo?
lines.learner: 일이 많아진 뒤부터요. 이러다간 못 버티겠어요.
lines.en: Since work got busy. At this rate, I can't hold on.
lines.roman: iri manajin dwibuteoyo. ireodagan mot beotigesseoyo.

lines.beaver: 혹시 나쁜 생각이 든 적도 있으세요?
lines.beaver_en: Have you ever had any dark thoughts?
lines.beaver_roman: hoksi nappeun saenggagi deun jeokdo isseuseyo?
lines.en: I have no thoughts of suicide. But I'm still scared.

lines.beaver: 말씀해 주셔서 고맙습니다. 술이나 약은 많이 드세요?
lines.beaver_en: Thank you for telling me. Do you drink or take pills a lot?
lines.beaver_roman: malsseumhae jusyeoseo gomapseumnida. surina yageun mani deuseyo?
lines.learner: 요즘 술을 자주 마셔요. 중독이 될까 봐 걱정이에요.
lines.en: I drink often these days. I'm afraid of addiction.
lines.roman: yojeum sureul jaju masyeoyo. jungdogi doelkka bwa geokjeongieyo.

lines.beaver: 정신과 진료와 상담을 같이 받아 보시겠습니까?
lines.beaver_en: Would you like psychiatric care and counseling together?
lines.beaver_roman: jeongsingwa jillyowa sangdameul gachi bada bosigetseumnikka?
lines.learner: 네, 정신과에 가 보고 싶어요. 소개해 주세요.
lines.en: Yes, I'd like to see a psychiatrist. Please refer me.
lines.roman: ne, jeongsingwae ga bogo sipeoyo. sogaehae juseyo.

lines.beaver: 네, 연결해 드릴게요. 명상도 도움이 돼요.
lines.beaver_en: Sure, I'll connect you. Meditation also helps.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, yeongyeolhae deurilgeyo. myeongsangdo doumi dwaeyo.
lines.en: I've never meditated. Will it help me psychologically?

lines.beaver: 네, 마음을 쉬게 해 줘요. 매일 십 분만 해 보세요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, it lets your mind rest. Try just ten minutes a day.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, maeumeul swige hae jwoyo. maeil sip bunman hae boseyo.
lines.learner: 알겠어요. 저한테도 재충전이 필요한 것 같아요.
lines.en: I see. I think I need to recharge too.
lines.roman: algesseoyo. jeohantedo jaechungjeoni piryohan geot gatayo.

lines.beaver_en: If it gets hard, contact the consultation room anytime.
lines.learner: 정말 감사합니다. 다음 주에 또 올게요.
lines.en: Thank you so much. I'll come again next week.
lines.roman: jeongmal gamsahamnida. daeum jue tto olgeyo.
